name: Local Services / Healthcare & Real Estate
description: Optimized for dental clinics, law practices, and real estate brokers with heavy inbound phone/WhatsApp volume.

knowledgeBase.title: Pricing & Insurance
knowledgeBase.content: We accept Delta Dental, Cigna, MetLife, and private pay. Consultations start at $150 or are fully covered by qualifying insurance plans.

knowledgeBase.title: Office Hours & Location
knowledgeBase.content: Open Monday through Friday 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Located at 450 Lexington Ave, Suite 400.

knowledgeBase.title: Emergency Dental Services
knowledgeBase.content: Same-day emergency visits are reserved for patients with severe pain or trauma if booked before 2:00 PM.
